steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Jesus taught "Love your neighbour as yourself" (Mark 12:31) and the Parable of the Good Samaritan (Luke 10:25-37) shows that Christians must help anyone in need, regardless of who they are. The local church puts this teaching into practice. | RS Exam Tips — The Role of the Church: 1. For The Role of the Church questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Role of the Church to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two ways the local church serves the community. | "The Church should focus on worship, not social action." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on RS Exam Tips — The Role of the Church, and one past-paper question.
